commands.checkTargeted: npx vitest run src/analysis/explain.test.ts src/calc/calc.test.ts src/concepts/concepts.test.ts

behavioralBaseline.tacticsOnMiss: feedback = 'Not the move — Retry the position, or move on.' ; board RESET to puzzle.fen ; lastMove cleared ; solution line NOT shown ; concept-card link shown only if first-exposure OR leech (showLearn).
behavioralBaseline.reviewOnMiss: feedback = review.missed ; board RESET to puzzle.fen ; grade(false) ; solution line NOT shown ; no concept card.
behavioralBaseline.calculateOnSubmit: phase='revealed' ; revealSolution() animates puzzle.moves at 350ms/ply on a view-only board AND prints t('calc.solution', { line: formatSanLine(san) }). This is the ONLY surface today that shows an animated solution + SAN line.
behavioralBaseline.coachOnResult: runAnalysis() computed in finishGame() ; full GameAnalysis discarded (only .dimensions used) ; result step renders ONLY <Radar> ; EvalGraph + criticalMoments NOT surfaced (CO13).

byteIdentityRefs.insightsStudyPlan: AP-COACH-1 — Insights/study-plan output must stay byte-identical (F4 must not alter it; F4 does not touch selection/profile).
byteIdentityRefs.explainPlyOutput: explain.test.ts pins headline/reasons/better in EN+FR. F4 must not change explainPly output (reuse only).
byteIdentityRefs.evalGraphOutput: EvalGraph not modified in F4 (consumed only by C6 later).
byteIdentityRefs.formatSanLineOutput: calc.test.ts pins formatSanLine. F4 reuses, does not change.

doctrineChecks.dbVersionBump: NOT required — F4 is presentational reuse; no new persisted fields.
doctrineChecks.pureCores: No new Date/Math.random in logic. The reveal component owns setTimeout (UI timing), matching Calculate's existing pattern; pure helpers (formatSanLine, theme->label) stay pure.
doctrineChecks.bilingual: Any new user-facing string lands FR+EN in src/i18n/messages/tactics.ts (collision-guarded).
doctrineChecks.honesty: trainer-miss 'why' is theme/motif-derived (no engine claim it doesn't have); no grade introduced.
